localChanges: chore: lock the engine packages that let Settlers be sent Road to or Railroad to a distant square

log: `BuildRoute` follows a path to a distant square and does a build action on each square of the way where the worker is offered it; `RoadTo` and `RailroadTo` are the two a ruleset offers (civ-clone/web-renderer#195). The order is a StrategyNote, saved with the game between squares and part way through a build; a `BuildingRoute` busy rule is rebuilt on load. Each step uses base-unit-action-goto's `moveOneStep`.

`moveAlongPath`'s step (choose the move, prefer a plain `Move` passing through, stop short of a last square that offers more than a move, report a blocked or failed step) is now `lib/moveOneStep`, returning `moved`, `failed`, `blocked` or `halted`. `moveAlongPath` uses it, unchanged in what it does; base-unit-action-build-route's Road to / Railroad to uses it too (civ-clone/web-renderer#195).

`civ1-unit:unit/action/road-to` and `.../railroad-to` (civ-clone/web-renderer#195): for a worker with moves left, on a square that isn't its own or a neighbour, with a route to it. Railroad to only once the player knows Railroad (`lib/routeOrders`, which a player with no research of its own passes as knowing nothing). The route the `goto` criterion found for the same journey is reused, so offering them costs no search of their own, and the order follows it through a PlannedPathFinderRegistry, as GoTo does.
`AdditionalData/routeOrders` lists, by name, the route orders a unit may be given, from the same `routeOrders`, so a renderer can offer them beside Go to without knowing the rule.
Needs library-unit 0.1.12 (RoadTo/RailroadTo) and adds library-science for the Railroad advance.
